measurement.comparison_scope: The before state is an exact master checkout; the after state is the final unit-size checkout.
measurement.accounting_scope: Node-owned heap blocks. Inline leaf parent-word bytes are attributed to the parent allocation and also reported separately as a non-additive view.

definitions.nodes: Unique reachable nodes in the trie graph. Shared nodes are counted once.
definitions.allocations: Heap blocks owned by the counted nodes, including node boxes and side allocations such as Vec storage. It is not the number of all build-time allocator calls.
definitions.requested_bytes: Sum of allocation sizes requested by the counted nodes before allocator rounding.
definitions.useful_bytes: Physical bytes in owned blocks occupied by live representation fields or payload: refcounts, masks, lengths/capacities, flags, live key bytes, live child pointers, and live values.
definitions.unused_bytes: Physical bytes in owned blocks not carrying live representation: alignment/tail padding, spare key slots, unoccupied pointer/value slots, and spare Vec capacity. By construction useful_bytes + unused_bytes = requested_bytes.
definitions.useful_occupancy_percent: 100 * useful_bytes / requested_bytes. This is physical representation occupancy and is never above 100%.
definitions.logical_key_bytes: Logical key-byte count retained as a diagnostic only. It is not physical occupancy and must not be divided by requested_bytes.
definitions.embedded_inline_bytes: InlineLeafNode uses an existing parent pointer word. Its 8-byte useful/unused split is shown separately as an attribution view; the same split is already included in the parent node-owned totals and must not be added again.
definitions.heap_delta_bytes: Live bytes observed by the counting global allocator during the build; it can differ from structural requested_bytes by a few non-node bytes.
definitions.build_alloc_calls: All allocator allocation/reallocation calls during the build, including temporary input and Vec growth.
definitions.malloc_estimate_bytes: Structural requested bytes rounded using the SizeStats glibc malloc model.
definitions.jemalloc_estimate_bytes: Structural requested bytes rounded using the SizeStats jemalloc size-class model.

accounting_model.policy: A complete fixed metadata field is useful even when some bits are zero; individual zero bits are not discounted. Uninitialized or spare storage is unused.

list.owned_layout: 64 B node: 4 B refcount + 42 B key buffer + 2 B header + two 8 B payload unions
list.useful_formula: 6 B fixed metadata + live logical key bytes + 8 B per live child pointer
list.unused_formula: requested_bytes - useful_bytes; includes unused key buffer, unused/value union space, and padding

dense.owned_layout: 64 B header + Vec capacity * 16 B OrdinaryCoFree entry
dense.useful_formula: 60 B header fields + 9 B per occupied entry (8 B Option child field + 1 B Option<()> value/absence flag)
dense.unused_formula: requested_bytes - useful_bytes; includes 4 B header tail padding, 7 B entry padding, and spare capacity

list.useful_formula: 6 B fixed metadata + live logical key bytes + 8 B per ordinary live child word; an inline leaf word contributes key_len + 1 B

inline.owned_layout: 8 B parent pointer word; not a node-owned allocation
inline.unused_formula: 7 - key_len bytes; this split is attributed to the parent word in the owned totals

compact.useful_formula: 4 B refcount + 3 B flags/length/capacity + live key bytes
compact.unused_formula: explicit header pad + trailing alignment + spare key capacity

sparse.useful_formula: 4 B refcount + 3 B flags/length + live key bytes + 8 B per ordinary live child word; an inline leaf word contributes key_len + 1 B
sparse.unused_formula: fixed padding + unused key slots + child slots without children

unit.owned_layout: 96 B header + Vec capacity * 8 B child pointer
unit.useful_formula: 4 B refcount + 32 B child mask + 32 B value mask + 24 B Vec descriptor + 8 B per ordinary live child word; an inline leaf word contributes key_len + 1 B
unit.unused_formula: 4 B header tail padding + spare child-pointer capacity

before.provenance: Exact master histogram data; useful/unused fields recomputed with accounting_model.before_master.

after.provenance: Direct measurement from the optimized unit-size checkout with physical accounting enabled.
